blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A 51-year-old tricycle driver visited a bank in Barangay Poblacion in Naga City in southern Cebu on Saturday, October 24, not to do any bank transaction, but to smash the bank’s glass door with a sledgehammer and a hammer to enter it. When police arrived, the driver was roaming inside the bank with the sledgehammer.
